toasts.passwordTooShortDescription: Password must be at least 8 characters long

passwordDialog.title: Change password
passwordDialog.description: Enter your current password and the new password

channels.title: Notification channels
channels.description: Choose the channels through which you want to receive notifications. In-app notifications always remain visible from the bell at the top of the screen, regardless of your choice here.

pushWeb.label: Push notifications (browser)
pushWeb.description: Receive push notifications in your browser

pushMobile.label: Push notifications (mobile)
pushMobile.description: Receive push notifications on the mobile app

sessions.singleSessionNote: Your organization allows only one active session: signing in on another device automatically signs this one out.
sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.description: Browsers and devices currently signed in to your account. Sign out any you do not recognize.
sessions.confirmOthersDescription_one: {{count}} other device will be signed out right away. You stay signed in on this one.
sessions.confirmOthersDescription_other: {{count}} other devices will be signed out right away. You stay signed in on this one.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Each time you sign in with your password, a 6-digit code is sent to you by email: knowing your password is no longer enough to get in.
twoFactor.enforcedHint: Your organization requires two-step verification for all its members: it cannot be turned off.
twoFactor.noPasswordHint: Your account signs in without a local password (directory or SSO): ask your administrator to turn verification off.
twoFactor.ssoHint: Microsoft or Google (SSO) sign-ins do not ask for this code: your identity provider runs its own verification.
twoFactor.enableDescription: To check that you receive the codes, enter the one we just sent you.
twoFactor.disableDescription: Confirm with your current password. Your account will then be protected by your password only.
